ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized in the central-to-outer areas of both lobes, bounded by a continuous low-intensity black region spanning the peduncle, notch area, and the entirety of the trailing edges. Numerous low-intensity linear and mottled streaks are distributed within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an approximate 80-degree angle at the vertex, dividing the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with frequent, high-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-15 pixel variance) along the continuous boundary from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white and grey pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are visible on the distal tips of both lobes and along the outer leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying thickness are present across the high-intensity white areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible white pigmentation; barnacle colonization present on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized circular voids or 'punched-out' marks within the black pigmentation on the central right lobe.
